brief.prompt: A smartphone mounted on a tripod at eye level faces a plain white wall beside a bright window, with a small strip of tape marking a standing spot on a wooden floor. A simple, uncluttered room in even daylight with no person present.
brief.alt: Smartphone on a tripod at eye level by a window, set up for consistent before and after face photos
brief.purpose: Teaches the standardised photo setup (fixed camera height, window light, marked position) for honest before and after comparisons
